name: rating-summary
title: Rating Summary
description: A big average rating ("4,9" with an Indonesian decimal comma) counts up while five stars fill, five bars (5 to 1 stars) grow to their shares, and the review count ("1.284 ulasan") counts up last. Score, shares and review count are variables.
useWhen: Backing a shop or product up with its average rating and how the ratings split.
A social-proof moment near the end of a promo.
avoidWhen: Individual customer quotes: use review-card-stack or chat-review-typed.
author: Mosio

source.technique: count-up and stagger: a number and bars growing to their real values

variables.label: Score
variables.description: Average rating out of 5. A comma or a dot works as the decimal mark.

variables.label: Shares
variables.description: Five numbers separated by commas: the percentage of 5-, 4-, 3-, 2- and 1-star ratings.

variables.label: Review count
variables.description: Shown last. Digits count up with dots as thousands separators; the words around them are kept.

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Small line above the score. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
